notes:
Company background: LumenPath provides a SaaS CX orchestration layer used by 120+ contact centers (support + sales). Primarily North America customers; several regulated clients in finance and healthcare.

Summary of need: Real-time agent assist with streaming suggestions (token-level streaming to agent UI), automated ticket summarization after call, CRM tool-calling (patch notes, update ticket status), and robust reliability under spikes (holiday/Black Friday volumes). Customer wants low end-to-end latency and deterministic failover to lower-cost models when capacity strained.

POC scope: 2-week POC in Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) with a VPC peering to their AWS account, demo of streaming suggestions integrated into their agent desktop, end-to-end latency benchmarks (p50/p95/p99), KV cache for prefix reuse, and a 48h synthetic spike test to validate graceful degradation and fallback routing.

Performance targets: p95 < 80ms for suggestion token latency, p99 < 120ms; throughput target 150 concurrent agent sessions with steady-state 30rps per agent during peak. Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to dedicated capacity if unit economics beat current inference costs by 20%.

Security & compliance: must satisfy SOC2 and SSO (SAML) integration, KMS-managed key support for token encryption at rest, audit logging for each model invocation, and data residency controls for EU and NA customers. They asked explicitly: "can we get per-request audit IDs and immutable logs for 1 year?"

Model preferences & guardrails: prefer open-model variants that can be quantized; want model pinning and automatic fallback chain (gpt-like-large -> gpt-like-medium) with safety filters for PII masking. Guardrails required: tool-call authorization checks, agent-visible confidence score, turn-level redaction suggestion, and a configurable profanity/brand-compliance blocklist.

Integration notes: will call Redwood API from agent desktop (WebSocket streaming) and perform server-side tool-calls to their ticketing system (internal API). Need SDK examples for streaming + tool-calling and sample policies for canary rollouts.

Quotes from stakeholders: "Latency is non-negotiable during peak — agents must not wait for suggestions." — Head of Support Ops. "If the fallback changes response quality we need regression alerts tied to eval prompt sets." — Platform Lead.

Commercial: initial ARR target $120-250k with expansion into managed private deployments for top-tier customers. Procurement timeline: legal and security templates in parallel with POC; target procurement by 2026-05.

Short-term next steps: kickoff POC (in progress), deliver streaming SDK sample by 2026-03-11, schedule security walkthrough 2026-03-18.

Notes style: bullets, shorthand, call references included above.
